citation.title: Variations in facial relationships: their significance in treatment and prognosis

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare exit 1). Differences settled: (1) citation.year a=1948 b=1949 -> 1949: merge ruling, cite the reprint on file (Angle Orthod 1949;19(3):145-155, page headers 'Vol. XIX, No. 3'); the original (Am J Orthod 1948;34:812-40) is named in caveats from the footnote on p. 145. Set id kept as downs1948. (2) #62 range high a=10 b=20 -> 20: page image p. 151 shows Table II '+3.5 +10 +14.5' and the text, which gives the range as +3.5 to +20 around a mean of +14.5 (merge ruling: +10 is a misprint, mean exceeds it). (3) source wording on all 10 rows (prose). Every value re-read from the page images: Table I p. 149 (PDF p. 5): 82-95 87.8; +10 to -8.5 0; -9 to 0 -4.6; 28-17 21.9; 66-53 59.4. Table II p. 151 (PDF p. 7): +1.5 +14 +9.3; 130 150.5 135.4; -8.5 +7 91.4; +3.5 +10 +14.5; -1 +5 +2.7. #6 table -4.6 vs text -4.8: table kept (merge ruling), noted. Sample p. 145: twenty individuals aged 12-17, about equally divided as to sex, clinically excellent occlusions -> ageBand [12,17], pooled, selection class-I (a had ideal-aesthetic; the paper selected on occlusion). No centre: Downs' means are sample means and his ranges the sample's range (owner B-2 notes). Scale not-stated. No SD anywhere.

caveats: Read from the reprint in Angle Orthodontist 1949;19(3):145-155 (the file on hand). Its footnote (p. 145) says the paper was first published in American Journal of Orthodontics, Oct. 1948, 34:812-40, and was first prizewinner of the AAO essay contest, 1948.
Sample (p. 145): twenty living individuals aged 12-17 years, roughly half of each sex, all with clinically excellent occlusions. No split by sex or age: every entry is pooled, 12-17.
Only means and ranges (minimal and maximal) are printed; no SD anywhere. The ranges are the sample's observed spread, not an ideal tolerance.
A-B plane (#6): Table I prints mean -4.6; the text (p. 148) says -4.8. The table value is stored.
Lower incisor to occlusal plane (#62): Table II prints the maximum as +10, below its own mean of +14.5; the text gives +3.5 to +20. The text's +20 is stored as the high end.
Lower incisor to mandibular plane (#56): Table II mixes deviation-from-90 range (-8.5, +7) with a full-angle mean (91.4); stored as the full angle (81.5 to 97, mean 91.4), as Fig. 12 prints it.
Ethnicity, film scale and head position are not stated. The one mm row (#63) is used as printed (assumed true size, owner ruling M-2).

entries.note: Printed '+10 to -8.5'; + when A is ahead of the facial plane (convex), - behind (p. 148), the catalogue's sign.

Table I (p. 149) prints the mean -4.6 (Fig. 6 p. 147 also -4.6); the text (p. 148) says 'The mean was -4.8'. The table value is stored (merge ruling). B behind A reads minus (p. 148), the catalogue's sign.
Downs' mandibular plane: tangent to the lower border at gonion and the lowest point of the mandible in the midsagittal plane (p. 150), the catalogue's tangent plane.
Minus when the posterior end drops past parallel with FH (p. 150), the catalogue's sign.
